subject: NexusGrid demo — sponsor availability & exec attendee plan
messages:
From: Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@nexusgrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nexusgrid.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec sponsor for Redwood demo (CIO attendance)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick screenshare last week. We're preparing an internal approval review and need a short demo that includes our CIO (Liam Chen) and one of our VP engineering leads. Our procurement team also asked for an executive-level walkthrough that focuses on latency/cost tradeoffs and dedicated deployment options.

Can you do a 45–60 minute session the week of Sept 20? Preferred windows for our execs are:
- Tue 9:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 13:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 10:00–12:00 PT

If possible, include a 10-minute pre-brief with Redwood’s sponsor so our CIO sees who will present the SLA/architecture sections. I attached a short RFP and compliance checklist for context.

Thanks — Evan

[Attachment: NexusGrid_RFP_Q3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@nexusgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sponsor for Redwood demo (CIO attendance)

Hi Evan — thanks for the context and the RFP. We can absolutely tailor the walkthrough to the CIO's priorities. Quick answers up front:
- We can do a 45-minute exec demo + 10-minute sponsor pre-brief.
- Ben (VP, Solutions) would be the sponsor for the pre-brief and will cover SLA + deployment modes.

Proposed slots that match your windows:
- Tue 21 Sep, 9:30–10:30 PT (pre-brief at 9:15)
- Wed 22 Sep, 13:30–14:30 PT (pre-brief at 13:15)
- Thu 23 Sep, 10:30–11:30 PT (pre-brief at 10:15)

Please let us know which one works for Liam and the VP lead. Also: do you want the demo to include a short Q&A on compliance (we can have our security lead on standby)?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sponsor for Redwood demo (CIO attendance)

Priya — I can take the sponsor pre-brief and the SLA section. Suggest we:
- Reserve Tue 21 Sep 9:15–10:30 PT as tentative (gives us a 15-min buffer).
- Have Marissa run the live demo portion; she knows the dedicated offering details and the private deployment checklist.
- Loop security (soojin or michael) only if the compliance checklist has redlines — otherwise include a 10-min compliance FAQ at the end.

I’ll prep a 3-slide SLA summary and a one-pager on deployment modes. Priya, can you send the final attendee list after Evan confirms?

—Ben
VP, Solutions
